_doc: Hand-placed counting lines; they win over the learned line in data/counting_lines.json (backend/counting.py load_overrides). Per camera id: {"line": [x1, y1, x2, y2], "segment": true|false} in 0..1 frame coordinates (x = left->right, y = top->bottom); segment=true counts only crossings between the two endpoints, false extends the line across the frame. Direction +1 is the right-hand side of p1->p2 as seen on screen (a line drawn left to right: + = towards the camera). Or {"exclude": true}: no road in view, the camera records no volume. Lines placed on frames of 2026-10-15 ~13:00 WIB (.scratch/lines audit).
